# AllYonoGuru

> AllYonoGuru (allyonoguru.com) is an independent directory of Yono-network Android game apps, including Rummy Guru and Teen Patti Guru, and a library of general rules guides for rummy and Teen Patti. App pages list each app's category and current download source; the guides explain rules, scoring and strategy and are not tied to any app.

AllYonoGuru is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to SBI, YONO by SBI, or any bank, and does not operate any listed app. Content is for adults (18+). Online money games are prohibited in India under the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025, in force since 1 May 2026; see the laws guide below for official sources. Some download links are referral links and are disclosed on each app page. Nothing on the site is legal or financial advice.
